layout.name: The Angled Halls
layout.theme: A ceremonial hall, oblique chambers and a sealed archive
layout.description: A ceremonial hall, oblique chambers and a sealed archive. Three successive 20 × 10 battle areas.

segments.name: The Processional Hall
segments.description: The broad entrance hall has an unequal service aisle along its southern edge and burial niches along the north. Its far doorway actually connects to the next area.

segments.name: The Oblique Chambers
segments.description: Three offset chambers turn around thick masonry. The central doorway offers the direct route; a southern passage reaches the eastern chamber around the broken partition.

segments.name: The Sealed Archive
segments.description: A guarded archive broadens into a final raised hall. Storage belongs against the side walls, leaving a clear approach and a narrower route past the northern rooms. The eastern wall is solid.
